statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-50195 allows local image tag poisoning through containerd's CRI checkpoint import (pkg/cri). It is patched only in the containerd/v2 module; no 1.x fix exists. The console vendors github.com/containerd/containerd only for registry-client packages (content, images, remotes/docker); pkg/cri is not vendored, so the vulnerable code is not present in the bridge binary. Kept although GHSA-cvxm-645q-p574 lists only the containerd/v2 module (so GHSA-fed scanners never match this v1 PURL): the Go vulndb alias GO-2026-5338 marks github.com/containerd/containerd v1 as affected from 0 with no fixed version, so module-level OSV matching (osv-scanner, trivy, govulncheck -scan module) flags this PURL - an OSV /v1/query for the module at 1.7.33 returns exactly this advisory and its two siblings. Symbol-level govulncheck does not reach the vulnerable code, which is this statement's justification.
